English: Hideworkers Lean-to
A basic shelter of hides and branches, where novice tanners and crafters process raw animal skins in the open air.
Tinkers Tent
A small, mobile tent for basic repairs and crafting of simple tools, maintained by a traveling tinker.
Basic Smithy
A rough forge set up with bellows and a portable anvil, allowing basic metalwork and weapon repairs.
Leatherworkers Yurt
A specialized yurt with tools for fine leatherworking, producing quality tack, armor, and supplies.
Carpenters Shelter
A sturdy, semi-permanent shelter for skilled woodworkers to craft wagons, bows, and defensive works.
Armorers Pavilion
A large, mobile pavilion dedicated to advanced smithing and armor crafting, supporting the hordes warriors.
Fine Tool Shop
A well-appointed workshop producing advanced tools, improving resource gathering and equipment quality throughout the camp.
Artisan Enclosure
A fortified, enclosed area housing several skilled artisan families, fostering innovation and craftsmanship.
Masterwork Workshop
A renowned workshop where master craftsmen create unparalleled arms, armor, and mobile structures for the elite.
River Nomad Artisan Guild
The pinnacle of nomadic craftsmanship, this great guild unites the finest smiths, tanners, woodworkers, and inventors under one banner, driving the river nomad hordes prosperity and might.
